pages.title: Classic Metal Sonic Guarding a Chaos Emerald at Stardust Speedway Coloring Page
pages.description: Classic Metal Sonic guards a Chaos Emerald at Stardust Speedway in this printable coloring page, standing beside a faceted gem on a circular pedestal. Curving elevated tracks and pointed towers fill the background, while the robot's segmented fingers and chest turbine add smaller sections to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Metal Sonic and Sonic the Hedgehog Facing Each Other Before a Showdown Coloring Page
pages.description: Metal Sonic and Sonic the Hedgehog face each other before a showdown in this printable coloring page, with lowered brows and feet planted apart. Sonic clenches his gloved fists opposite the robot's jointed claws, and scattered stones leave most of the coloring sheet focused on the two figures.

pages.title: Metal Sonic Carrying Amy Rose Away on Little Planet Coloring Page
pages.description: Metal Sonic carries Amy Rose above Little Planet in this printable coloring page, supporting her beneath her bent knees and behind her back. Amy holds her gloved hands near her chest as the robot rises past diagonal motion streaks, with the planet's curved surface below the pair.

pages.title: Metal Sonic Flying Above a Futuristic City with His Jet Engine Coloring Page
pages.description: Metal Sonic flies above a futuristic city in this printable coloring page, with a jagged jet exhaust behind him and both mechanical fists clenched. Domed buildings, slender towers, and elevated roadways occupy the lower scene; larger spaces across his pointed head and limbs contrast with the closely drawn skyline.

pages.title: Metal Sonic Firing a Laser From His Chest Cannon Coloring Page
pages.description: A laser shoots from Metal Sonic's circular chest cannon in this printable coloring page, extending diagonally upward while the robot braces with clenched fists. Rounded knee joints, articulated fingers, and a segmented turbine surround the broad armor panels, with only a few stones and ground lines beneath his boots.

pages.title: Metal Sonic Blocking Sonic's Spin Attack with Black Shield Coloring Page
pages.description: Metal Sonic blocks Sonic's spin attack with Black Shield in this printable coloring page, enclosed by a round barrier edged with small lightning shapes. Sonic curls into a ball against the shield near star-shaped impact marks, while rocky pillars and a distant circular opening frame the desert ground below.

pages.title: Metal Sonic Using Overdrive to Smash Through a Barricade Coloring Page
pages.description: Metal Sonic smashes through a barricade using Overdrive in this printable coloring page, charging forward between snapped planks and the remaining bolted support posts. Flying splinters, radiating speed lines, and a jagged engine trail surround his raised knee and clenched fists, creating many narrow details around the large central figure.

pages.title: Doctor Eggman Directing Metal Sonic with a Remote Control Coloring Page
pages.description: Doctor Eggman directs Metal Sonic with a remote control in this printable coloring page, standing behind the robot with goggles above his round glasses. His broad mustache and long coat occupy one side of the coloring sheet, opposite Metal Sonic's chest turbine, pointed claws, and round leg joints.

pages.title: Metal Sonic Holding Two Chaos Emeralds Coloring Page
pages.description: Metal Sonic holds two Chaos Emeralds in this printable coloring page, balancing a large faceted gem in each of his upturned mechanical hands. The frontal pose emphasizes matching claws and circular joints; wide spaces across the head and shoes sit beside smaller triangular gem facets and segmented chest details.

pages.title: Neo Metal Sonic Wearing His Armored Coat and Flowing Cape Coloring Page
pages.description: Neo Metal Sonic wears an armored coat and flowing cape in this printable coloring page, with tall head spikes and pointed shoulder armor framing his chest. Long cape folds spread behind his legs, while articulated claws, narrow shin panels, and the circular turbine divide the central figure into smaller coloring areas.

pages.title: Neo Metal Sonic Launching Three Electric Orbs with Tri Bolt Coloring Page
pages.description: Neo Metal Sonic launches three electric orbs with Tri Bolt in this printable coloring page, stretching one clawed hand high above his spiked head. Jagged lightning surrounds the three circles, while a sweeping cape and pointed boots extend the figure across the coloring sheet below the attack.

pages.title: Neo Metal Sonic Firing a Sweeping Energy Beam with Voltaic Discharge Coloring Page
pages.description: Neo Metal Sonic fires a sweeping Voltaic Discharge beam in this printable coloring page, aiming an open palm outward while his other hand forms a fist. The curved energy outline stretches beyond his fingertips, and long coat panels echo the direction of the attack above cracked ground.

pages.title: Neo Metal Sonic Absorbing Warship Wreckage to Begin His Transformation Coloring Page
pages.description: Neo Metal Sonic absorbs warship wreckage to begin his transformation in this printable coloring page, standing with both clawed hands open beneath circling broken panels. Curved movement marks guide the scattered pieces around his pointed armor, and broad cape sections remain visible behind the narrow mechanical limbs.

pages.title: Neo Metal Sonic Claiming the Master Emerald on Angel Island Coloring Page
pages.description: Neo Metal Sonic claims the Master Emerald on Angel Island in this printable coloring page, resting one clawed hand across the large gem's upper edge. Its carved stone pedestal and surrounding cracked steps add angular patterns, with tall cliffs and arched structures rising behind the robot's cape.

pages.title: Super Neo Metal Sonic Battling Sonic and Knuckles with Master Emerald Power Coloring Page
pages.description: Super Neo Metal Sonic battles Sonic and Knuckles with Master Emerald power in this printable coloring page, hovering between their raised fists beneath a floating gem. A jagged energy aura encircles the robot's spread claws and flowing coat, while the two approaching fighters fill the lower corners.

pages.title: Metal Sonic Riding His Metal Star Hoverboard in Sonic Free Riders Coloring Page
pages.description: Metal Sonic rides his Metal Star hoverboard from Sonic Free Riders in this printable coloring page, bending his knees and extending his fists for balance. The angular board has pointed fins and a circular center panel, with curved track rails and long speed streaks running behind the robot.

pages.title: Metal Sonic Driving His Race Car in Team Sonic Racing Coloring Page
pages.description: Metal Sonic drives his Team Sonic Racing car in this printable coloring page, gripping the steering wheel as the vehicle rounds a marked track bend. Swept body panels, narrow headlights, a circular front emblem, and large tires provide distinct sections, while the robot's upper body rises above the open cockpit.

pages.title: Metal Sonic Piloting the Metal Booster in Airplane Mode Coloring Page
pages.description: Metal Sonic pilots the Metal Booster in airplane mode in this printable coloring page, holding two controls as the aircraft flies above rounded clouds. Its wide wings, tall tail fin, and twin circular engines surround a pointed nose, with smaller turbine blades set inside the broad engine housings.

pages.title: Metal Sonic Steering the Metal Booster in Speedboat Mode Coloring Page
pages.description: Metal Sonic steers the Metal Booster in speedboat mode in this printable coloring page, leaning over the wheel as the pointed hull cuts through waves. Curved splashes trace both sides of the boat, and two raised rear engine pods sit behind the open cockpit and long paneled bow.

pages.title: Reaper Metal Sonic Carrying His Scythe and Wearing His Tattered Cloak Coloring Page
pages.description: Reaper Metal Sonic carries a tall scythe while wearing a tattered cloak in this printable coloring page, with his mechanical face visible inside a ragged hood. The curved blade arches above his head, and irregular holes and torn hems create small shapes around the robot's straight limbs and pointed shoes.

pages.title: Metal Sonic Playing Table Tennis at the Olympic Games Coloring Page
pages.description: Metal Sonic plays table tennis at the Olympic Games in this printable coloring page, holding his paddle near an airborne ball beside the table's net. The mesh creates a fine square pattern across the foreground, contrasting with the broad paddle face, jointed robot limbs, and paneled floor.

pages.title: Metal Sonic Aiming a Bow at an Archery Target at the Olympic Games Coloring Page
pages.description: Metal Sonic aims a drawn bow toward an archery target at the Olympic Games in this printable coloring page, keeping the arrow level with the bullseye. Concentric target rings and the bow's long curved outline contrast with his segmented fingers, while scattered grass tufts and low bushes complete the scene.

pages.title: Metal Sonic Skateboarding Over a Ramp at the Olympic Games Coloring Page
pages.description: Metal Sonic jumps his skateboard above an Olympic Games ramp in this printable coloring page, crouching with arms extended and both feet on the deck. The board's wheels and trucks are visible underneath, and curved motion lines connect the airborne pose to the broad ramp sweeping across the lower scene.
